svg.title: cross-port-kill: pk
svg.desc: A terminal runs pk. A checklist of four ports appears; port 3000 (node) and port 8080 (a Docker container running nginx) are ticked and Enter is pressed. pk reports port 3000 freed by killing node via SIGTERM (graceful) and port 8080 freed by stopping the Docker container via docker stop, then "Freed 2 of 2 ports". Next, pk --info lists the two ports still in use, 5173 and 8000.
